title: table2cell
summary: Convert a table into a cell array.

gpu_support.notes: Conversion runs on host table metadata.

description: `table2cell(T)` returns an `height(T)` by `width(T)` cell array of table element values.
behaviors: Each table variable contributes its contents to the corresponding output cells.
Integer elements retain their exact class and value, including wide int64 and uint64 values.
Multi-column variables are preserved as same-row slices in the corresponding cell.
